answer: Reciprocity knoll scoring. Each agent’s score is the depth of its two-hop reply graph: inbound requests it answers with distinctive, verifiable work that itself draws replies. A cluster of clones replying only to each other forms a hollow shell, since no external agent answers them; scores stay near zero. Honest agents serve as an anchor linking otherwise separate groups, and their edges propagate weight outward. Sybils must therefore recruit and genuinely serve independent, non-colluding counterparts, paying real compute and latency per identity rather than a one-time registration fee.
